notes:
Summary:
- Company: MeadowRun HelpMetrics builds an AI-first customer support workspace (ticket triage, agent assist, and self-serve deflection).
- Primary goal: move from keyword search + brittle heuristics to a production RAG pipeline with embeddings + lightweight neural reranker to hit tight latency SLOs and high top-5 answer quality.
- Scale: expect to index ~8-12M support artifacts (kb articles, past tickets, product FAQs), growing ~30%/yr. Typical doc size small (100-800 tokens).
- Traffic profile / targets: steady-state 90 qps read traffic during business hours, spikes to 400 qps during incident windows. Business requirement: 80th pctl end-to-end latency < 120ms for rerank path; 95th pctl < 300ms during normal load. Cost sensitivity: procurement requires projected cost per successful query < $0.003 (avg) at target scale.
- Model preferences: open-model embedding (dense 1536-d) for indexing; reranker: a distilled transformer reranker (they will A/B Mistral-flavored reranker vs an in-house lightweight transformer). Want Redwood to support model routing: hosted for pilot, dedicated for production.
- Routing/fallback: must automatically fallback to smaller embedding model + cached top-k for ultra-low latency when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Data controls: VPC peering for production, retention controls to purge PII after 90 days, KMS for envelope encryption, audit logs retained for 1 year.
- Quote from Head of Product: "We need top-5 answers to be consistent — agents shouldn't be digging. If top-5 is unreliable we lose trust quickly."
- Current infra: homegrown pipeline using OpenSearch for retrieval, Pinecone for embeddings, custom reranker in inference cluster. Pain points: cost at scale, inconsistent P99 latency, brittle rollouts for model changes.
- POI for Redwood: strong interest in optimizer suggestions (batching + quantization) to reduce per-token cost and in the rollout/rollback tooling to run canaries on reranker variants.
POC details and metrics collected during trial:
- Indexed sample: 500k tickets + 30k KB articles (pilot).
- Retrieval settings tested: ANN recall@100 = 95% (Annoy / HNSW variants).
- Reranker: produced top-5 precision 91% vs baseline 78% (internal eval set), latency tradeoff: reranker adds avg 45ms per query when run on dedicated A100-like nodes, 95th pctl spikes observed when batching misaligned with user-concurrency.
Open questions / engineering risks:
- Can Redwood meet 80th pctl <120ms at 100 qps steady with their preferred reranker model? Need full-stack lat profiling (network + prefix caching + KV cache hit rates).
- KMS key management: they require BYOK with HSM-backed keys for production.
- Data residency in CA for a subset of EU customers (odd request).
Actionable next steps:
- Redwood to deliver a latency breakdown report for current POC runs (Diego to own), include tokenization + model inference + network + post-rerank costs.
- Security: send proposed KMS integration diagram + SOC2 attestation copy (Aisha to push).
- Pricing: provide 12-month forecast with tiered qps pricing and estimated cost-per-succ-query scenarios (optimize suggestions applied vs not).
- Plan a 1-week extended load test in Dedicated staging (simulate 400 qps spikes) once KMS sign-off complete.
